card: Adds explicit timeouts to HTTPConnection instances in the test suite and enforces keyword-only timing arguments for wait_until. Without these timeouts, tests can hang indefinitely on broken systems rather than failing with an informative timeout error. This is a low-risk test reliability cleanup to avoid stalled test runner jobs.
evidence: PR description: 'Without a timeout, the test can hang forever on broken systems. This is fine, but it would be nice if the test instead failed with a nicer error message, indicating the timeout.'
problem: Tests without HTTP timeouts can hang forever on broken or unresponsive systems, tying up test runners instead of failing promptly with an informative error.

risk.why: A mistake would only cause spurious timeouts or test failures in the functional test suite.

scope_notes: Small test framework adjustment modifying 7 lines across 5 files.
summary: Adds explicit timeouts to HTTPConnection usages in the functional test framework and converts wait_until timing parameters to keyword-only arguments. This ensures tests fail cleanly with a timeout message rather than hanging indefinitely when connections stall.
uncertainties: Diff was not provided, but commit titles and PR description clearly define the small test scope.
